correctness.rationale: With quandle e_i e_j=e_(2j−i), the vector-space identification with B=K[X]/(X^p−1) gives star(F,G)=σ_(-1)(F)σ_2(G) in associative B. J=(X−1) is nilpotent of degree p; augmentation-zero idempotents recursively lie in J^(2^k), hence vanish. For augmentation-one units, truncated log/exp are inverse group homomorphisms because all surviving total degrees are <p; log transforms idempotency into h=σ_(-1)(h)+σ_2(h). For t=log X, automorphisms act t↦at, giving scalar condition (1−(−1)^j−2^j)c_j=0. Even j are excluded; odd j are allowed iff ord_p(2) divides j−1, yielding exactly m_p affine free coordinates, q^m_p+1 elements over F_q. Exhaustive independent direct-product checks p=3,5 agree; exact truncated-log/exp identity checks at p=7,17,31 corroborate the higher-dimensional phenomenon. Scope strictly odd p with coefficient characteristic p.
